briefings.title: What David Senra Learned Studying 400+ Founders
briefings.tldr: The definitive trait shared by history’s greatest founders is an absolute, obsessive focus—the ability to "mute the world and build your own"—driven by a compulsive need for control and a deep founder-problem fit, rather than a desire for wealth or a well-balanced life.

briefings.title: My Conversation With Marc Andreessen, Co-Founder of a16z & Netscape

people.name: Marc Andreessen
people.role: Co-founder and General Partner, Andreessen Horowitz (a16z)

briefings.tldr: The most effective entrepreneurs optimize for impact over happiness and succeed through a lack of introspection and a high resistance to neuroticism.
